mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ADM_TABLES WHERE OWNER = #{schema}
SELECT t.owner as schema, t.table_name, nvl(t.num_rows, 0) numRows, nvl(t.avg_row_len, 0) avgRowLen FROM ADM_TABLES t WHERE t.OWNER = #{schema} order by numRows asc

select c.owner as schema, c.table_name, c.column_name as name, c.data_type, c.data_length, c.data_precision, c.data_scale, c.nullable, c.column_id from ADM_TAB_COLUMNS c WHERE c.OWNER = #{schema} and c.table_name= #{name} order by c.column_id asc

select c.owner as schema, c.table_name, c.column_name as name, c.data_type, c.data_length, c.data_precision, c.data_scale, c.nullable, c.column_id from ADM_TAB_COLUMNS c WHERE c.OWNER = #{schema} order by c.table_name, c.column_id asc
SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMNS FROM ADM_INDEXES WHERE IS_PRIMARY = 'Y' AND OWNER = #{schema}
SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMNS FROM ADM_INDEXES WHERE IS_PRIMARY = 'Y' AND OWNER = #{schema} AND TABLE_NAME = #{name}
select count(1) from (select 1 from ${schema}.${name} limit 1) t
select ${param.colName} from ${param.schema}.${param.name} where ${param.colName} >= #{param.preValue} order by ${param.colName} asc LIMIT #{param.offset}, 1
SELECT s.${param.colName} FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY ${param.colName} ASC) AS rn, ${param.colName} FROM ${param.schema}.${param.name}) s WHERE MOD(s.rn, #{param.offset}) = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ADM_TABLES WHERE OWNER = #{schema} LIMIT 1
